mapper.sql: po.id, po.family_id, po.meal_session_id, po.user_id, po.status, po.note, po.avoidances, po.expected_time, po.submitted_at, po.confirmed_at, po.confirmed_by, po.created_at, po.updated_at, po.deleted, u.nickname as user_nickname
mapper.select:
select
from personal_order po left join `user` u on u.id = po.user_id where po.id = #{id} and po.family_id = #{familyId} and po.deleted = 0 limit 1

select oi.dish_name_snapshot, sum(oi.quantity) as amount from personal_order po inner join order_item oi on oi.order_id = po.id where po.family_id = #{familyId} and po.meal_session_id = #{mealSessionId} and po.deleted = 0 and po.status in ('CONFIRMED', 'COOKING', 'COMPLETED') group by oi.dish_name_snapshot order by oi.dish_name_snapshot asc
